text_block_list.name: Pisa's Friend
text_block_list.text:
Waaah. This wire puzzle is way too hard! 
Pisa, why don't you give it a try~?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
No. I'm not really good with... cast 
puzzles.

text_block_list.name: Pisa's Friend
text_block_list.text:
"It's fine, it's fine! It definitely won't 
come undone!"

text_block_list.name: Pisa's Friend
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh! Pisa, you're free from the spell! 
...Wait, huh!? Why do you look so 
shocked!?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
And just like that, you untied it. Even 
though we were finally connected...
